problem:
Catherine mixes $3.4$ liters of alcohol with $0.68$ liters of orange essence. What is the volume of the mixture?

                            
                                    
                                        
                                            

                                                

                                        
                                        
                                        

                                    
                                
                                    
                                        
                                        Expressed as a decimal, the volume of the mixture is

                                    
                                
                                    
                            
                                        {{field-1}}                
                                    
                                
                                    
                                        
                                        
liters.
worked_solution:
To determine the volume of the mixture, we need to calculate the sum $3.4+0.68.$

There is $1$ decimal place in $3.4$ and $2$ decimal places in $0.68.$

To add the numbers, they both need to have the same number of decimals. Hence, we rewrite the first number so that it has $2$ decimal places:

$$
3.4=3.40
$$

Next, we line up the decimal points:

$$
\begin{aligned} &  & \,\,\,\,3\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,.\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,4\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,0\,\,\,\, \\ \,\,\,\,+\,\,\,\, &  & \,\,\,\,0\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,.\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,6\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,8\,\,\,\, \\  &  &  & \,\,\,\,.\,\,\,\, &  & \end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we proceed by adding the two numbers just as we would with whole numbers:

$$
\begin{aligned} &  & \,\,\,\,\begin{aligned} \\ 1\end{aligned}\,\,\,\, &  &  \\  &  & \,\,\,\,3\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,.\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,4\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,0\,\,\,\, \\ \,\,\,\,+\,\,\,\, &  & \,\,\,\,0\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,.\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,6\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,8\,\,\,\, \\  &  & \,\,\,\,4\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,.\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,0\,\,\,\, & \,\,\,\,8\,\,\,\,\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the volume of the mixture is $4.08$ liters.
